chaptersRef.description: Reference to an externally hosted chapters file.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the chapters file (e.g. application/json+chapters).

main.description: A podcast episode. Record key is a UUIDv5 derived from the podcast GUID (as namespace) and the episode's feedItemGuid (as name), enabling deterministic lookup from RSS feed metadata.

alternateMedia.description: Alternate versions of the episode media (e.g. different formats or audio-only versions of video episodes).

artwork.description: Episode-specific artwork. Overrides the podcast artwork when set. Recommended: 1400x1400 to 3000x3000 pixels, square, no alpha channel.

chapters.description: Reference to an externally hosted chapters file.

createdAt.description: When the episode record was created.

description.description: A description or show notes for the episode.

duration.description: Duration of the episode in seconds.

episodeNumber.description: Episode number within its season or the overall series.

episodeType.description: The type of episode. Defaults to full.

explicit.description: Whether the episode contains explicit content. Overrides the podcast-level setting when set.

feedItemGuid.description: The original feed item identifier. Must match the <guid> element of the corresponding RSS feed item. The record key (rkey) is derived from this value as uuid5(<podcast:guid>, feedItemGuid).

link.description: URL of a companion webpage or show notes page for the episode.

media.description: The primary media file for the episode.

podcast.description: Identifies the parent podcast. Since episodes live in the same repository as their podcast, the AT URI is always derivable from the episode's DID and the podcastGuid.

transcript.description: References to externally hosted transcript files (e.g. VTT, SRT, JSON). Multiple entries allow providing transcripts in different formats.

mediaRef.description: Reference to an externally hosted media file.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the media file (e.g. audio/mpeg, video/mp4).

transcriptRef.description: Reference to an externally hosted transcript file.

language.description: Language of the transcript (ISO 639-1 two-letter code, e.g. 'en', 'es', 'pt').

mimeType.description: MIME type of the transcript file (e.g. text/vtt, application/x-subrip, application/json).
